label: Every edge of the studied causal history is efficient causing in some respect
paraphrase: OPEN analyst bridge: every edge of the causal relation whose history is studied (cause y x: y is a direct upstream cause of x) is an efficient causing of x by y in some respect. Converse direction of STMT-PER-SE-LINKS-IN-FINITE-HISTORY-RELATION. A history relation that also records material or final dependence, or bare temporal succession, falsifies it.
